ready2_open_rewrite.final_cot: Image description: This is a food web diagram, in the diagram there are organisms such as Zooplankton (zooplankton) and Guppies (guppies/small fish). The arrow points from Zooplankton to Guppies, indicating that guppies eat zooplankton. Reasoning: The question says that if another animal that also eats zooplankton enters this community, then this new animal and guppies will use the same food source. Because both depend on zooplankton, guppies may need to compete with this new animal for food.
